title: The Institution Hidden Inside the Contract
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A fashion contract does more than price a transaction: it assigns roles, approvals, rights, records, risk, credit, access, transition duties, and the rules that govern what happens when the relationship changes.
The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.
narrativeSequence.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · BEFORE — What enters the relationship?. Define parties, authority to sign, pre-existing materials, references, confidential inputs, third-party components, permissions, territory, intended channels, and the difference between background assets and new deliverables.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · DURING — How does work move?. Specify deliverables, milestones, dependencies, review windows, named approvers, revision rounds, acceptance, change control, credit, documentation, source-file delivery, accessibility, and rights evidence. The schedule is a governance map.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · CONTROL — Who may do what with the result?. Separate ownership from license; identify exclusivity, fields of use, territory, term, sublicensing, modification, archive, publicity, moral-rights issues where applicable, and statutory work-made-for-hire or transfer requirements.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · AFTER — What survives change?. Map payment on termination, kill fees, return or deletion, archive copy, confidentiality, transition help, continuing licenses, credit correction, takedown, dispute procedure, and who retains the evidence needed to enforce or explain the deal.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

mapping.prompt: Draw the full workflow from source material to final archive and attach a responsible party to every handoff.
Mark every approval, acceptance, revision, payment, credit, rights, access, and record obligation.
Run delay, scope change, infringement claim, nonpayment, termination, incapacity, acquisition, and collaborator-dispute scenarios.
Give the actual draft, facts, jurisdiction, leverage constraints, and desired outcomes to qualified counsel before signature.
